name: Fraudulent Transaction Data 4
definition: Data related to the confirmed fraudulent transaction.

Authorisation.name: Authorisation
Authorisation.definition: Indicates whether the transaction was authorised or not.

AuthorisationEntity.name: Authorisation Entity
AuthorisationEntity.definition: Indicates the entity which authorised the transaction (if relevant). P000-P999 reserved for private use, N000-N999 reserved for national use.

MessageReason.name: Message Reason
MessageReason.definition: Reason for sending the message.||The ISO 8583 maintenance agency (MA) manages this Message reason code list.

AlternateMessageReason.name: Alternate Message Reason
AlternateMessageReason.definition: Supports message reason codes that are not defined  in external code list.

PresentmentCycle.name: Presentment Cycle
PresentmentCycle.definition: Indicates the cycle of presentment or of the chargeback  (1= first cycle for chargeback, 2= second cycle of presentment or chargeback, etc.).

AgentDisputeBundleCaseReference.name: Agent Dispute Bundle Case Reference
AgentDisputeBundleCaseReference.definition: Bundle dispute case reference assigned by agent.

AgentDisputeCaseReference.name: Agent Dispute Case Reference
AgentDisputeCaseReference.definition: Dispute case reference assigned by agent.

AcquirerDisputeCaseReference.name: Acquirer Dispute Case Reference
AcquirerDisputeCaseReference.definition: Dispute case reference assigned by acquirer.

IssuerDisputeCaseReference.name: Issuer Dispute Case Reference
IssuerDisputeCaseReference.definition: Dispute case reference assigned by issuer.

FraudulentMessage.name: Fraudulent Message
FraudulentMessage.definition: Complete or partial details of the original message identified as fraudulent.
